title: kith-store: OutboxStore
description:
OutboxStore: enqueue, get_due, record_failure, mark_delivered with exponential backoff.

**What:** OutboxStore wraps &Connection and implements the outbox retry queue: insert pending deliveries, fetch due entries, update backoff, and remove on success.

**Algorithm:**
1. Define pub struct OutboxStore<'a> { conn: &'a Connection }
2. enqueue(message_id: &str, peer_user_id: &str, peer_mailbox_host: &str, now_unix: i64) -> Result<(), KithError>:
   INSERT INTO outbox(message_id, peer_user_id, peer_mailbox_host, next_attempt_at, attempt_count) VALUES(?,?,?,?,0)
3. get_due(now_unix: i64) -> Result<Vec<OutboxEntry>, KithError>:
   SELECT * FROM outbox WHERE next_attempt_at <= ? ORDER BY next_attempt_at LIMIT 50 (uses outbox_next index)
4. record_failure(message_id: &str, last_error: &str, now_unix: i64) -> Result<(), KithError>:
   a. SELECT attempt_count FROM outbox WHERE message_id=?
   b. Compute delay: min(60 * 2^attempt_count, 3600) seconds  (cap at 1 hour)
   c. UPDATE outbox SET attempt_count=attempt_count+1, last_error=?, next_attempt_at=now+delay WHERE message_id=?
   d. If attempt_count >= 10: call mark_failed (move to permanent failure)
5. mark_delivered(message_id: &str) -> Result<(), KithError>:
   DELETE FROM outbox WHERE message_id=?
6. mark_failed(message_id: &str, last_error: &str) -> Result<(), KithError>:
   UPDATE messages SET delivery_state='failed' WHERE id=?; DELETE FROM outbox WHERE message_id=?

**Defensive programming rules:**
- LIMIT on get_due prevents runaway batch sizes
- Backoff capped at 3600s to prevent unbounded delays
- last_error truncated to 500 chars before storage (prevent oversized error blobs)
- Never log message body content; log only message_id and error string

**Tests (independent oracle):**
- Enqueue then get_due(now) returns the entry (oracle: manually computed timestamps)
- get_due(before_next_attempt) returns empty (not yet due)
- record_failure increments attempt_count and doubles delay
- After 10 failures, mark_failed is called; delivery_state='failed' in messages
- mark_delivered removes the outbox row

**Acceptance:** cargo test -p kith-store: all OutboxStore tests pass; clippy clean.
